parts.title: Part 3 · Dictation
parts.instr: Your teacher reads the dictation. Write what you hear in the box.
chunks: I do not waste a lot of time
and the surface of the sea
a mass of hills and valleys.
There has been a wonderful improvement
I do not mind you smoking

parts.text: As a rule, I do not waste a lot of time worrying about unimportant details. Last night, there was a terrible storm and the surface of the sea looked like a mass of hills and valleys. There has been a wonderful improvement in his health and he is now beginning to enjoy life again. Wisdom usually comes with experience. Although he objected, he was still defeated. I do not mind you smoking while I am eating.
